posts.caption:
Busan's seafood markets are worth visiting. Just agree on the details first. 🐟

Before anything is prepared, confirm the seafood and weight, the price, the preparation method, and any per-person table-setting or cooking fees. Ask for the total on a display or an order slip.

Full local checklist and Korean phrases: link in bio (go2busan.com). Prices and fees vary by shop.

posts.caption:
Landing in Busan? Here is the simple version. ✈️

On a budget, compare the Gimhae light rail to Sasang, then Metro Line 2. With heavy luggage, a group or a late arrival, a taxi can be easier. Check the last train and bus times for your actual landing time.

Full route guide: link in bio (go2busan.com). Routes, fares and hours can change.

posts.caption:
That fish cake skewer in a paper cup has a port-city story. 🍢

'Busan eomuk' is a regional food and production tradition, not one single recipe or brand. Fish, busy markets and small workshops all shaped it. Our local guide covers the documented history with sources.
